reply_text:
I replied to Pree in the #central-team thread. Nothing she can see confirms the 23 May date or contradicts it.

- **What I checked:** the public files and the #central-team history. There's nothing about Thornbury Cloth Co.: no order form, no CRM notes and no earlier mention.
- **Why the date looks off:** today is 14 October 2026, so 23 May this year has already passed. Either they meant May 2027 or the date is out of date.
- **What I suggested:** get the date confirmed in writing by the Thornbury contact or the account owner before anyone plans around it. I said I wouldn't treat it as a real deadline until then.

I didn't use search, because its results include conversations Pree can't see.
